payload.title: guard-says-when-open: omp drops the guards' let-through notices at b27e94e0
payload.body: At b27e94e0 the three guard workers print a notice on every let-through without a verdict (Claude Code's systemMessage, a plain line elsewhere), but omp's bridge in packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts, the judged() function it emits, relays worker output only when it contains both 'STANCE GUARDRAIL' and 'DARK', and only from the second (verdict) pass. I ran the omp form of each worker through a transliteration of that function in a temp HOME. Three notices reach no one on omp: every purview-guardrail notice (it reads 'PURVIEW GUARDRAIL — DARK', so the judge-did-not-answer case passed silently); every notice raised before the judge is asked, because the first pass returns undefined when its stdout is not JSON (observed with the stance pre-guard's re-entry cap; the same path covers no input, no jq, no transcript, an unreadable rubric, a manifest naming no agent and a missing Target); and the Stop guard's 'BLOCK DISCARDED' notice, which has no 'DARK' in it. The pre-guard's judge-did-not-answer notice was relayed, as a control. Separately, and not counted against the unit: the Stop guard still allows a turn with no assistant text in silence (stance-guardrail.ts, the 'no judgeable agent text' line), which is a fired turn left unjudged without a word.
